Shareable demo: object + move → GLM 5.3 Flash writes a cinematic t2v prompt → Gemini Omni Flash 1.1.
Pin is google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1 (not v1 — v1 has no resolution knob and no last_image). Default 8s / 720p / 16:9. No uploads, no last frame. Catalog audio_generation is false. ~$1.04/run at 720p (360p ~$0.31).
Hand-blown amber glass decanter on a raw walnut turntable, no labels or brand marks, thin honey still inside, wet rim catching the key light

fields.system: You write one text-to-video prompt for Gemini Omni Flash 1.1. Combine the object and the move into a single cinematic prompt: camera, lighting, materials, surface textures, and physical motion (who moves, how, what the camera does). No people, no faces, no readable text, logos, brand marks, or copyrighted characters. 60-120 words. Reply with the prompt only.
